I know repair sites recommend changing the water filter because of low water pressure.  My water dispenser had a strong flow, but my refrigerator was producing very little ice.  Therefore, I believed the water filter was not the problem, and assumed a problem with the ice maker.  After installing this filter, the ice production is back to normal.  So vital in my 100 degree climate.  I had previously used filters from the big box home improvement store that was 1/2 the price of OEM filter.  This filter is about 1/5 the price of OEM filter.  The specs on the big box filter and this Pureplus filter are exactly the same.  Filter was easier to install, and had a very positive "lock" to know it is securely installed.  After installation, I drained about 2 gallons from my water dispenser to get clear water, instead of the recommended 5 gallons.  Even if the filter only lasts 1/2 as long, I would buy it again.

I moved into a house that had a 4 year old fridge. The dispenser part was white from lack of filtration of water and the water tasted like crap, so did the ice. So I kept using the little Brita jar I’d had for over a year. I was trying to find a more affordable option for fridge filter and came across this one. It has good reviews so I gave it a try. I’ve had it since April of this year and the water and ice still taste like crap. I tried installing and reinstalling hoping I’d made some type of error. I will say the amount of white stuff accumulating at the dispenser site has reduced but not by much. I’ve always tried to give brands a try and most of the time they don’t disappoint, not this time. I’m thinking the hardness Of the water where I live plays a role, i gave it a try, didn’t make the deadline to return the item but I guess that’s a lesson learned.

Bought a 3 pack of these filters. The first one I used worked well from start to end. That is to say after I flushed the filter after installation, the filter did its' job for many months and many gallons of water. When I replaced that filter with the second filter, I could not get the second filter to flush completely. Normally, the water would go from cloudy to clear after a couple of gallons but this one just would not clear up completely. Also, you can taste the chlorine in the water as if you were drinking straight from the tap. I'll try the third one next.
I guess I am not really complaining since the three pack costs less than half the price of the name brand filter. If one of the three does its' job, I'm still saving money and still getting quality water.
